# Ordinary (non-plugin) library with the code shared by the plugins, the tests and
# c4hProvDump: provenance metadata storage, PodioFile and its helpers, and the
# provenance dump. Sources are src/*.cc and public headers Code4hep/IO/*.h. Each file
# is compiled once, here, so a process that links this library and also loads the
# plugins has a single copy of every function.
# The target name, IO, is derived from the directory; depend on it with DEPS Code4hep/IO.
c4h_add_library(
    DEPS
        FWCore/Framework
        FWCore/ParameterSet
        DataFormats/Provenance
        Code4hep/PodioUtilities
    EXT_DEPS
        podio::podio
        podio::podioIO
        EDM4HEP::edm4hep
        Boost::program_options
        Python3::Python
)

# <library name="Code4hepIOPlugins" file="*.cc"> (EDM_PLUGIN=1)
# Only the framework modules; everything else comes from the IO library.
c4h_add_plugin(
    NAME Code4hepIOPlugins
    SOURCES plugins/*.cc
    ${_c4h_shared}
    DEPS
        Code4hep/IO
        FWCore/Framework
        FWCore/ParameterSet
        DataFormats/Provenance
        Code4hep/PodioUtilities
    EXT_DEPS
        podio::podio
        podio::podioIO
        EDM4HEP::edm4hep
        Python3::Python
)
